rule.title: 1099-Q code 3: the earnings were taxable in the prior year

citation.wording: 3—Excess contributions plus earnings taxable in the prior calendar year

rule.open_point: The other half of this finding — a CESA's year-end FMV in box 7 replacing the box 2/3 split — is the Pub. 970 worksheet, a computation; it is not applied.
